scope: Development calibration, two AppWorld train scenarios, one seed each; no new method or confirmatory inference
selection_rule: From the first 12 sorted public train instructions: first all-target scenario and first cross-app set reconciliation scenario; take _1 only. No solution, metadata, evaluator or model outcome used.
interpretation: FOCUS adaptation, not reproduction of original model, tokenizer, agent or reported scores
Appendix A.9 joint planning and rescue in each of three draft calls; rescued union is kept regardless of frequency
Native function calling and public assistant content; internal model reasoning is not compressed into visible spans
All arms can read immutable archived spans and repeat public API queries at counted cost
Ledger is model-extracted from visible observations; source checks are not semantic verification
Final official evaluation runs only after frozen execution and is never returned to generation
No claim of same-intermediate-state causal effect; runs begin from fresh identical task databases
decision_rules: If simple ledger or existing defensive compression suffices, do not invent an additional mechanism
If no compression occurs, the trial does not test the memory mechanism
If full history also fails, classify task/tool/budget failure before attributing failure to compression
Report every executed trial including infrastructure, unknown usage and incomplete failures
